briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and Google Gemini 3 race toward multimodal AGI thresholds as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for regulatory leverage. Compute shortages and talent wars intensify the global AGI competition.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-1.5 with extended context; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 surpasses Llama 4 on key benchmarks. Meta open-sources Behemoth-70B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to xAI and Microsoft; TSMC reports record AI chip demand; new U.S. data center builds face power grid delays.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will compute rationing or open-source proliferation determine the winner of the AGI race by 2028?
